more_info.question: Property Insights and Arabian Ranches 2 Floor Plans

data.answer:
Arabian Ranches 2 master plan includes luxurious townhouses and stand-alone villas available for sale and rent. Samara, Lila, Rosa, Rasha, Casa, and Yasmin feature 3 to 6-bedroom villas. The townhouses in the area consist of 4 and 5 bedrooms.

Popular Communities in Arabian Ranches 2

There are eight villa communities in the area: Casa, Lila, Palma, Rasha, Rosa, Yasmin, Samara and Azalea, while Reem and Camelia are the two townhouse communities in the neighborhood. Here are some of the information about each district:

Samara

Offering a family-centric lifestyle, Samara features stand-alone villas inspired by Spanish architecture. There are around 177 houses in Samara, including properties with 3, 4, and 5-bedroom layouts. It is located close to the main entrance of the development.

Reem Community

Reem Community is a popular option for renting or buying townhomes. It is a gated community featuring 216 townhouses. The townhouses in Reem Community are available in 3-bedroom configurations.

Casa

Casa features six types of stunning Moroccan-style villas, including 3 and 4-bedroom layouts. Those looking to invest in modern yet reasonably priced properties can buy villas in Casa.

Palma

The sub-community of Palma Arabian Ranches 2 is dominated by villas that range between 3,168 sq. ft. and 3,488 sq. ft., offering generous space and multifunctional areas. These houses include 3 to 5 bedrooms, making them ideal for families seeking ample living space.

Lila

Lila is also a family-centric community comprises 219 smartly-designed villas in 3 to 5-bedroom configurations. With low-pitched terracotta roofs and accents of delicate wrought-iron fencing, the houses are an effortless interpretation of coastal Spanish architecture. 

Camelia

You can find various off-plan townhouses for sale in Camelia that promise long-term returns on investments. Many ready properties are also available for rent and sale. The cluster has 177 units of 3 and 4-bedroom residences with balconies and private backyard gardens.

Rasha

Composed of only 140 villas with 4 to 6 bedrooms in each unit, Rasha Arabian Ranches 2 offers exclusivity. Launched in 2014, the residential properties are inspired by Spanish architecture and offer supreme-quality finishes.

Rosa

The sub-community of Rosa encompasses 144 Mediterranean-inspired homes, crafted in five different layouts. Offering 5 and 6 bedrooms, these villas include various multifunctional family rooms, study areas, home offices, and rooms for house help.

Yasmin

For those looking to buy luxurious 6-bedroom villas, Yasmin is the ideal location. Featuring 98 exclusive Arabesque-style villas, Yasmin Arabian Ranches 2 offers five types of villas with 4, 5, and 6-bedroom floor plans.

Azalea

Complementing the rustic backdrop of Arabian Ranches 2, the newly-launched Azalea community features 108 intricately designed residences with 3, 4, and 5-bedroom layouts. These culturally-inspired villas offer hints of Arabesque designs and patterns.

Buying a Property in Arabian Ranches 2

Looking for Arabian Ranches 2 for sale property? The sale price of independent villas in Arabian Ranches 2 starts from AED 3.1M and goes up to AED 7.5M. Apart from the aforementioned areas, the residential properties are featured in newly developed sub-communities such as Palma, Azalea, and Camelia. A 3,000 sq. ft. 3-bed villa for sale in Arabian Ranches 2 can be purchased for a minimum price of AED 1.6M.

For buying 4-bed villas in Arabian Ranches 2, prices start at AED 2M. More luxurious units, like 5-bed villas, are offered at an average sales price of AED 4M, featuring between 4,300 sq. ft. and 5,000 sq. ft. of covered area. Larger properties, such as 6-bed villas spanning across 8,000 sq. ft., are priced from AED 6.5M.

There are several townhouses for sale in Arabian Ranches 2, concentrated in the newer sub-developments of Camelia and Reem. These include 3 and 4-bedroom units ranging from 1,970 sq. ft. to 2,960 sq. ft. One can buy 3-bed houses in Arabian Ranches 2 starting from AED 1.6M, while 4-bedroom townhouses for sale require a minimum investment of around AED 2M.

Rental Properties in Arabian Ranches 2

Searching for Arabian Ranches 2 property for rent? A typical 3-bedroom Arabian Ranches 2 villa for rent would cost around AED 140k per year. These properties are chiller-free, ready to move in, and have private lawns and maid’s rooms.

There are a few townhouses in Arabian Ranches 2 available at an affordable rental rate. These are typically in a 3-bedroom configuration, with prices starting from AED 125k per year.

The rental price for a 4-bedroom villa starts at AED 170k. Those needing immediate occupancy can opt for ready-and-furnished units in Casa, which are around 4,000 sq. ft.

If you're looking to rent a luxurious 5-bedroom villa, prices start at approximately AED 220k per year. For a more spacious 6-bedroom villa of around 6,000 sq. ft., the annual rent can go up to AED 350k.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Arabian Ranches 2?

Those with private transport can easily access the central city via Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street (D54), which connects to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311). The sub-community is also served by other key routes, with Al Qudra Road (D63) to the south and Emirates Road (E611) to the east.

While crowded areas and narrow streets can be challenging for car owners, Arabian Ranches 2 offers ample parking spaces. The streets and driveways are designed to provide sufficient space between parking bays, and each house in the community has parking space for at least two cars.

Residents of Arabian Ranches 2 have access to several supermarkets within and near the community. Popular options include Carrefour Market, which offers a wide range of groceries and household items, and the Arabian Ranches 2 Souk, which houses a variety of retail outlets, including a supermarket. These stores provide convenient shopping options for daily needs, ensuring residents don't have to travel far for their essentials.

For shopping enthusiasts, Arabian Ranches 2 is well-served by several nearby malls. The Ranches Souk is the major Arabian Ranches 2 mall that offers a range of retail, dining, and entertainment options. 
Nearby, the Mall of the Emirates, one of Dubai's largest and most popular shopping destinations, is just a short drive away. It features a vast array of international brands, dining options, and entertainment facilities, including Ski Dubai. Another option is the Dubai Marina Mall, which offers a comprehensive shopping and dining experience.

Schools and Nurseries in Arabian Ranches 2

Arabian Ranches 2 offers excellent learning facilities within the community. Notable schools include Arabian Ranches 2 Nursery and Ranches Primary School. Additionally, there are several training centers, such as Dubai Kids Kung Fu, Brooklyn Melodies Music and Dance Centre, and Step Up Academy, a ballet school.

Reputable educational institutions like Jumeirah English Speaking School and GEMS Vertus School are nearby Arabian Ranches 2 schools. For higher education, Dubai International Academic City, located just 20 minutes away, hosts universities such as Khalifa University Dubai, Al Ghurair University Dubai, and Manipal University Dubai, among others.

Arabian Ranches 2 provides easy access to various places of worship to cater to its diverse community. For Muslims, the Al Salam Mosque is located within Arabian Ranches 2, offering a convenient place for daily prayers and community gatherings. Other nearby mosques include the Al Rahman Mosque and Masjid Salam, both within a short driving distance.

For Christians, the St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church and the Christ Church Jebel Ali are approximately a 20-minute drive away, offering regular services and community activities. Hindu residents can visit the Shiva Temple in Bur Dubai, which is around a 30-minute drive from Arabian Ranches 2.

Residents of Arabian Ranches 2 have access to quality healthcare facilities within a reasonable driving distance. Mediclinic Arabian Ranches is the nearest clinic, located just 10 minutes away, providing comprehensive medical services and urgent care.

For more extensive medical needs, the Mediclinic Parkview Hospital and Saudi German Hospital are about a 15 to 20-minute drive away, offering a wide range of specialized medical treatments and emergency services. Additionally, the Al Zahra Hospital Dubai, known for its state-of-the-art facilities and expert medical staff, is approximately 25 minutes from Arabian Ranches 2.

Arabian Ranches 2 Location & Nearby Areas

Arabian Ranches 2 is strategically located in the heart of Dubai, offering easy access to major highways and destinations. 

The community is just a few minutes from Arabian Ranches, which offers additional amenities and recreational facilities. Dubai Motor City and Dubai Studio City, about 10 minutes away, provide diverse dining, shopping, and business options. 

Dubai Sports City, around a 15-minute drive away, features various sports facilities, while the Mall of the Emirates, a 20-minute drive away, offers extensive retail, dining, and entertainment options. Dubai Marina, approximately 25 minutes away, provides upscale dining and stunning waterfront views. Arabian Ranches 2's prime location ensures residents enjoy convenient access to a wide range of facilities and attractions, enhancing their overall lifestyle experience.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Arabian Ranches 2

data.answer:
Arabian Ranches 2 offers a variety of activities and amenities for residents and visitors to enjoy. The community is home to lush parks and well-maintained walking and cycling paths, perfect for outdoor enthusiasts. Families can spend quality time at the numerous playgrounds and sports facilities, including tennis courts and swimming pools. The Ranches Souk provides a convenient shopping and entertainment hub with retail stores, cafes, and a supermarket. Additionally, the Arabian Ranches Golf Club nearby offers an 18-hole championship course, a popular spot for golf enthusiasts.

Restaurants in Arabian Ranches 2

Arabian Ranches 2 restaurants cater to a variety of tastes. The Ranches Souk features several restaurants and cafes, such as Carluccio’s, serving Italian cuisine, and Chez Sushi, offering fresh Japanese dishes. Paul's Bakery is a popular spot for French pastries and light meals. Additionally, the nearby Arabian Ranches Golf Club offers fine dining at its restaurant, Ranches Restaurant, known for its international menu and stunning golf course views.

Beaches Near Arabian Ranches 2

While Arabian Ranches 2 is an inland community, several beautiful beaches are within a short driving distance. 

Jumeirah Beach, located about 25 minutes away, offers pristine sands and clear waters, perfect for a day of relaxation and water activities. Kite Beach, approximately 30 minutes away, is popular for kite surfing and other beach sports. For a more luxurious beach experience, residents can visit the beaches along the Palm Jumeirah, which are about a 35-minute drive away and offer stunning views and upscale beach clubs.

Hotels in Arabian Ranches 2

While there are no hotels directly within Arabian Ranches 2, several options are available nearby. The Arabian Ranches Golf Club features a boutique hotel with comfortable accommodations and easy access to the golf course and clubhouse facilities. 

For more extensive amenities, the nearby area of Dubai Marina, about 25 minutes away, offers a range of luxury hotels such as the Address Dubai Marina and Grosvenor House. The Mall of the Emirates area, approximately 20 minutes away, also provides various hotel options, including the Kempinski Hotel Mall of the Emirates, known for its upscale services and direct access to the mall's shopping and entertainment.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Arabian Ranches 2 Dubai

Arabian Ranches 2 enjoys proximity to several notable attractions and landmarks in Dubai. The Dubai Miracle Garden, located about 15 minutes away, features vibrant floral displays and themed gardens, making it a popular spot for families and tourists.

The Global Village, also around a 15-minute drive, offers a cultural and entertainment extravaganza with pavilions representing countries from around the world, live performances, and diverse dining options. The Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, approximately 10 minutes away, is a must-visit for motorsport enthusiasts, offering go-karting and racing events. For a touch of luxury, the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are about a 25-minute drive away, providing world-class shopping, dining, and the iconic skyscraper experience.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

Arabian Ranches 2 offers a variety of outdoor activities and wellness facilities for residents. The community is designed with numerous parks, walking and cycling paths, and sports facilities, including tennis courts and swimming pools. For beauty and wellness, residents can visit several salons and spas within the community, such as Tips and Toes for nail and beauty treatments and NStyle Beauty Lounge for a range of services. Fitness enthusiasts have access to well-equipped gyms, including Fitness First and Optimal Fitness, offering state-of-the-art equipment and various fitness classes.

When considering living in Arabian Ranches 2 Dubai, there are a few factors to keep in mind. Owning a private vehicle is advantageous for commuting and accessing the wider city.

Arabian Ranches 2 is a residential community in Dubai that offers unparalleled luxury and comfort. Developed by Emaar Properties, it features a range of elegantly designed villas and townhouses.

Arabian Ranches 2 is part of Dubailand and was developed in 2013. Its state-of-the-art fitness facilities include swimming pools, sports courts, and fully equipped gyms.

Spanned over 1.5 million sq. m., the community is situated near major road networks, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road, providing residents excellent connectivity to key areas of the city.
